Definition: from G5228 and G3591; bulging over, i.e. (figuratively) insolent:--great swelling.
BiblicalUsage: hypéronkos is the word for swelling, arrogant speech. In 2 Peter 2:18, the text says "For when they speak great swelling [words] of vanity."
TheologicalSignificance: In hypéronkos I find no hidden theology; it simply means swelling, arrogant speech.
